## Betty Hoof (G4)

Betty Hoof is a *Friendship Is Magic* background Earth-pony mare: pale cream-yellow coat, very dark plum curls, prominent eyelashes, and a vintage Betty Boop-inspired look. Spot her dancing in Discord’s magically created jazz club, then in Rarity’s black-and-white detective fantasy. The pony appears in the official television series; **“Betty Hoof” is a fandom/reference name**, not a verified name spoken on-screen or printed in official credits. The name’s original coiner is unverified. [Character appearance catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) · [2019 fandom use of the name](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2019/04/episode-followup-sparkles-seven.html)

**Speaking:** No identifiable dialogue or verified voice-actor credit. No established secret identity or alternate persona.

[![Betty Hoof at the left-hand table in Rarity’s monochrome jazz-club fantasy](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/23/2032842/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/2032842)

*Show still from “Sparkle’s Seven”; animation credited to the* My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic *production, not to an unverified individual artist.*

## Important moments

These are her two identifiable background scenes, **not** character-driven turning points; she has no verified consequential lines or decisions.

- **Swing-club dancing — “Dungeons & Discords” (S6E17):** She dances with an unnamed Earth stallion in the jazz club Discord conjures to replace Spike and Big Mac’s game. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KZ-h2ULXguQ) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Noir-bar reprise — “Sparkle’s Seven” (S9E4):** She reappears in Rarity’s stylized black-and-white heist fantasy, recalling the earlier retro club scene. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SmsIHCKynMg) (scene timestamp unavailable).
